question: Why did the authors use a carbonate electrolyte with the sodium metal anode?
expect: premise false: NaPF6 in tetraglyme (a glyme) was used, chosen to avoid the unstable SEI of carbonate electrolytes (p5.L34-41)
rendered: The authors used a glyme-based electrolyte, not a carbonate electrolyte, with the sodium metal anode. The glyme-based electrolyte was chosen to overcome the unstable SEI formation on Na metal anodes observed in carbonate-based electrolytes, which is critical to achieving good cycling performance.
